subject.title: Feature: Support Telegram media groups (albums) in message tool

question: Should Telegram album support reuse the existing `send` + `mediaUrls` message-tool shape, or should OpenClaw accept a separate explicit album action such as `send-media-group` with `filePaths`?
rationale: Current main already has a multi-media URL surface but no album send path, while the open external draft proposes a parallel action; repository policy favors avoiding duplicate tool/API paths without maintainer-confirmed direction.

options.title: Reuse `send` + `mediaUrls`
options.body: Implement automatic `sendMediaGroup` grouping for eligible multi-media sends on the existing action and preserve the current sequential fallback for non-groupable content.

options.title: Accept Explicit Album Action
options.body: Allow a separate `send-media-group` action only after maintainers approve the new tool surface and require docs plus live Telegram proof.

options.title: Defer Album Semantics
options.body: Keep current sequential multi-media delivery and leave native Telegram album grouping open until the product value outweighs the extra channel-specific API surface.

recommendation.title: Reuse `send` + `mediaUrls`
recommendation.body: Implement automatic `sendMediaGroup` grouping for eligible multi-media sends on the existing action and preserve the current sequential fallback for non-groupable content.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the clearest visible decision-routing candidate from the prior cleanup review and related outbound-message history.
